Maya — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We can support a temporary uplift but want to align on three things: 1) duration/volumes, 2) how you want to handle pricing for the uplift window, and 3) true-up cadence.

Quick proposal:
- Provision an ephemeral surge buffer of 2.25M tokens/day for a 72-hour window.
- Apply your existing committed unit price for the first 1.5M tokens/day; overrun beyond that during the window billed at a one-time blended uplift (commit price + 18% surcharge) to avoid a full rate tier swap.
- True-up monthly with a single reconciliation invoice after the month closes (we'll net any prepaid buffer).
- We can offer a one-time partner credit of $8,000 if you sign a short addendum that documents the uplift and the true-up cadence.

I attached a pricing sketch (redwood-pricing-v3.xlsx) and a simple SOW template for the uplift. Ben and Laura are looped for any finance/legal details. If that looks ok, we can provision the buffer and get it into your portal.

Best,
Grace
